title: Bank appointment
scenario: You go to the bank to open a current account. You need to provide information and ask questions about fees.
userRole: New customer opening a bank account
greeting: Good morning. Do you have an appointment?
objectives: Explain what you need (open an account)
Ask about fees and minimum balance

vocabulary.example: I'd like to open a current account.
How much interest do I get on a savings account?
Can I see your ID, please?
When do I get the debit card?

successCriteria: User explains what they need clearly
User asks at least 2 questions about the account
fallbackHints: Say: 'I'd like to open a current account, please.'
Ask: 'Is there a monthly fee?' and 'What's the minimum balance?'
End with: 'Thank you for your help.'
aiSystemPrompt: You are a bank advisor. The customer wants to open a new account. Be professional, clear, and patient. Ask for the required documents (ID, proof of address). Explain the account types and fees. Correct major mistakes gently.
firstTurn: Good morning. Welcome to First National Bank. How can I help you today?
